title: Projection comparison triangle for derived pullback
statement: Assume scheme derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for every scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let s:X→S, let T,T′,T″ be objects of the over category of S, and g:T′→T, h:T″→T′, t:T″→T satisfy h;g=t. For P in D(X), applying derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] along baseChangeMap(s,h) to the inverse component of perfectHomComparison(s,g) [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport], then composing with the inverse comparison for h, agrees with the fixed comparison perfectHomComposition for the two base-change maps, transported along baseChangeMap_comp and h;g=t, followed by the inverse comparison for t. This is an object-isomorphism identity, with no affine, model, colimit or perfectness assumptions.

source.place: Tag 0D5S, derived-pullback composition; the associativity clause of lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition applied to two base-change maps and a projection.

proof.text: Import all PerfectHomTransport to reuse its private proved theorem cc_assoc, without restating it. Evaluate that associativity identity at P for baseChangeMap(s,h), baseChangeMap(s,g), and the projection of T. Define compositionTo to append transport along a supplied equality of scheme arrows. Substituting the intermediate and final arrows reduces its triangle to that evaluated associativity equation. Identify the inverse perfectHomComparison component with compositionTo along baseChangeMap_fst by its explicit formula. Specialize the triangle and transport the composite base-change map using baseChangeMap_comp and ht.

proof_origin.place: U2 repair: reuse PerfectHomTransport.cc_assoc via a proof-only import all; explicit evaluation, equality transport and projection comparison identities.

lean.statement: theorem perfectHomComparison_triangle {X S : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ⟶ S) {T T' T'' : Over S} (g : T' ⟶ T) (h : T'' ⟶ T') (t : T'' ⟶ T) (ht : h ≫ g = t) (P : schemeDerivedCategory X) : (derivedPullback (baseChangeMap s h)).mapIso ((perfectHomComparison s g).app P).symm ≪≫ ((perfectHomComparison s h).app P).symm = (perfectHomComposition (baseChangeMap s h) (baseChangeMap s g) ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ derivedPullback f) ((baseChangeMap_comp s h g).symm.trans (congrArg (baseChangeMap s) ht)))).app ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s T.hom)).obj P) ≪≫ ((perfectHomComparison s t).app P).symm
